meta.title: Christmas Day 2026 dining — Windsor, Maidenhead & Paddington
meta.researchNote: Researched snapshot only. Facts were read from official venue web pages and official menus on the date shown. Prices, menus, sittings and availability can change. Reconfirm everything directly with the venue before booking. No table availability has been checked for any venue.

items.title: No National Rail or Elizabeth line trains on Christmas Day or Boxing Day
items.detail: National Rail's official engineering-works notice for London Paddington (Dolphin Junction upgrade) states, for both the Elizabeth line and Great Western Railway: "As part of the closure of the railway on Christmas Day and Boxing Day, no trains will run." This means no trains between Windsor/Maidenhead/Slough and Paddington on Friday 25 December 2026.

source.title: National Rail — Major engineering work London Paddington (26 Dec 2026 – 3 Jan 2027)

items.title: Paddington engineering works continue until 3 January 2027
items.detail: From Sunday 27 December to Sunday 3 January, no GWR trains run between Slough and London Paddington; Elizabeth line trains do not run between Reading and Paddington from 27 to 30 December. National Rail says GWR trains between Slough and Windsor & Eton Central / Maidenhead operate normally in that period. Relevant if you plan London trips just after Christmas.

source.title: National Rail — Major engineering work London Paddington (26 Dec 2026 – 3 Jan 2027)

items.title: London Underground and London buses on 25 December — official 2026 details not verified
items.detail: TfL's official Christmas pages could not be read during research (the site required browser verification). Press coverage of previous years describes no Tube and no TfL bus service on Christmas Day, but this has NOT been verified for 2026 from an official TfL source. Check tfl.gov.uk before relying on any London public transport on 25 December.

source.title: TfL — Christmas and New Year travel (official page; not readable during research)

items.title: Smith's Bar & Grill (Paddington) advises car or taxi on Christmas Day
items.detail: Smith's own Christmas Day page says: "Trains and the Tube do not run on Christmas Day, so plan to come by car or taxi. There is no parking on site." This is the venue's statement, not an official transport source.

implications: If you are staying in Windsor without a car, a Paddington Christmas meal depends entirely on pre-booked private transport (taxi or private hire). Taxi availability, holiday fares and journey times for 25 December were not researched and are not estimated here.
Venues in central Windsor are the lowest-risk option: check the walking route from your temporary housing using each venue's directions link once you know your address.
Maidenhead and Bray venues are separate towns from Windsor; with no trains on the day, you would need a booked taxi or private hire both ways.
Ask your relocation provider or corporate housing team whether they can recommend a local taxi firm that takes advance Christmas Day bookings.
